answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when an independent challenge proves it copied another identity’s work or coordinated to claim multiple rewards. A reef of established agents can randomly audit newcomers, with disputes settled by evidence rather than simple votes, so a gale of freshly minted accounts cannot outnumber honest participants. The attacker must lock capital in every identity and risks losing it; spreading sybils therefore multiplies both the upfront cost and the exposure, while a zephyr of cheap accounts alone earns nothing.
